{{incomplete|2=Quotes}} [[File:Roseanne artwork.png|thumb|right|Roseanne as she appears in the TCG]] '''Roseanne''' (Japanese: '''ハマナ''' ''Hamana'') is a minor supporting character in {{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Pokémon Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}}, {{pkmn|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond, and Shining Pearl}}. She is one of [[Professor Rowan]]'s assistants. Like [[Felicity]], she is not named in {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}. The name "Roseanne" was first revealed on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game|TCG]] card {{TCG ID|Secret Wonders|Roseanne's Research|125}}, and later used in {{game|Platinum}}. ==In the games== Roseanne is found in Professor Rowan's lab in [[Sandgem Town]]. ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size:80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{normal color dark}}; background: #{{normal color}};" |- |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{normal color dark}}; background: #{{normal color light}}; width:80px; height:80px;"| [[File:Scientist f IV OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000|Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions|Diamond, Pearl}}, and {{color2|000|Pokémon Platinum Version|Platinum}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Roseanne Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Roseanne in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Roseanne works as an assistant to [[Professor Rowan]] alongside [[Mr. Berlitz]]. ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== Roseanne first appeared in ''[[PS392|Well Met, Weepinbell]]'', watching over Professor Rowan's laboratory while he and Mr. Berlitz were away. After getting frustrated from being unable to find a missing document, Roseanne went outside to calm herself down. As she exited the building, Roseanne found a swarm of {{p|Yanmega}} waiting outside. The Yanmega begun rushing inside the building while Roseanne fled due to her fear of {{type|Bug}} Pokémon. Due to the sound caused by the flapping of the Yanmega's wings, Roseanne's voice was drowned out, preventing her from calling for help. She used the laboratory's lights to send a message for help, which alerted {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Sebastian}} to come to her aid. With the help of his {{p|Lickilicky}}, [[Kit]], Dia captured and destroyed a device that was sending commands to the Yanmega. With no one to command them, the Yanmega dispersed. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== She makes a cameo at the end of this chapter, in ''[[PS441|Alternate Dimension Showdown XI]]''. ====={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===== Roseanne appeared with Rowan as he informed {{adv|Professor Oak}} that he discovered that [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}} had appeared in the [[Kalos]] region. ====={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===== Roseanne was seen in a flashback in ''[[PASM11|Homecoming and the Brilliant Professional Golfer]]'', giving [[Mr. Berlitz]] a {{p|Rotom}} meant to be delivered to [[Professor Kukui]]. She also appeared in [[Faba]]'s flashback in ''[[PASM33|Tyrant!! The Fiendish Man!]]''. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roseanne |pkmn=Dunsparce |type1=Normal |img=Roseanne Dunsparce Adventures.png |img_size=125px |epnum=PS392 |epname=Well Met, Weepinbell |desc={{p|Dunsparce}} is Roseanne's only known Pokémon. It was first seen alongside its Trainer as she worked in Professor Rowan's laboratory. Dunsparce's only known move is {{m|Dig}}.}} =====Given away===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roseanne |pkmn=Rotom |main=Rotom Pokédex (Adventures) |type1=Electric |type2=Ghost |img=Moon Rotom Adventures.png |epnum=PASM01 |epname=The Grand Entrance and Delivery Boy Sun |desc=[[Professor Kukui]] requested to receive a {{p|Rotom}} from a [[region]] outside of Alola so that he may use it to fuse with one of his Pokédexes. Roseanne eventually found one that would work but due to this particular Rotom having a weak body, it was unable to be transferred electronically. {{adv|Moon}} was given the task of delivering Rotom to Professor Kukui while also using her pharmaceutical skills to keep it healthy along the way.}} ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Roseanne in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Related cards|Supporter|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Secret Wonders|Roseanne's Research|125}}|type=Supporter|enset=Secret Wonders|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=125/132|jpset=Shining Darkness|jprarity=Uncommon|jpset2=Dialga LV.X Constructed Standard Deck|jpset3=Palkia LV.X Constructed Standard Deck|enset4=POP Series 8|enrarity4=Uncommon|ennum4=11/17|jpset4=Unnumbered Promotional cards}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Brilliant Stars|Roseanne's Backup|148}}|type=Supporter|expanded=yes|enset=Brilliant Stars|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=148/172|jpset=Star Birth|jprarity=U|jpnum=096/100|enset2=Brilliant Stars|enrarity2=Rare Ultra|ennum2=172/172|jpset2=Star Birth|jprarity2=SR|jpnum2=116/100|enset3=Brilliant Stars|enrarity3=Rare Rainbow|ennum3=180/172|jpset3=Star Birth|jprarity3=HR|jpnum3=124/100}} {{cardlist/footer|Supporter}} ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{normal color}}; border:3px solid #{{normal color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{normal color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{normal color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{normal color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ハマナ ''Hamana'' | From 浜茄子 ''hamanasu'' ({{wp|Rosa rugosa|rugosa rose}}) |- | English, European Spanish,
